title: Follow the Policy, Fail the Benchmark: Auditing and Revising Policy-Based Decision Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2611.07042v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Policy-based decision benchmarks evaluate whether systems apply written rules to financial and operational cases. Yet a rule-following response can be marked wrong when the benchmark misstates the required decision. We audit nine public policy-based decision benchmarks through source tracing, program execution, and controlled checks. We find unsupported targets, reference errors that survive replay or propagate as solved steps, and evaluators that reject acceptable answers or credit incomplete decisions. To measure the scoring impact, we rescore unchanged model responses. On the 96 LegalBench SARA numeric cases, correcting the scorer raises acceptance by more than 80 percentage points for each of three models, without changing references or responses. In RuleArena Tax, restoring a required zero floor changes 27 of 300 references and narrows an observed model gap. A controlled federal-exemption task with explicit ownership and eligibility

translated_title: 遵循政策却未通过基准测试：审计与修订基于政策的决策基准
translated_abstract: 基于政策的决策基准用于评估系统是否将书面规则应用于财务和运营案例。然而，当基准测试错误地陈述了所需决策时，遵循规则的回答可能被标记为错误。我们通过来源追溯、程序执行和受控检查，对九个公开的基于政策的决策基准进行了审计。我们发现了无依据的目标值、在重放中依然存在或作为已解决步骤传播的参考错误，以及拒绝可接受答案或给不完整决策加分的评估器。为衡量评分错误的影响，我们在不更改模型回答的前提下重新评分。在96个LegalBench SARA数值案例中，仅纠正评分器就使三个模型的接受率各提高了超过80个百分点，而无需改变参考答案或模型回答。在RuleArena税务任务中，恢复所需的零下限改变了300个参考答案中的27个，并缩小了观察到的模型差距。在一个明确了所有权和资格条件的受控联邦豁免任务中……
tldr: 论文审计了九个基于政策的决策基准，发现其中存在参考错误和评分缺陷，仅通过修正这些基准问题即可使模型接受率提升超过80个百分点，表明基准质量对模型评估结果有决定性影响。
en_tdlr: This paper audits nine policy-based decision benchmarks and uncovers reference errors and scoring flaws; correcting these benchmark issues alone boosts model acceptance rates by over 80 percentage points, showing that benchmark quality critically determines evaluation outcomes.
